page.name: House of the Page
page.note: where they first spoke, in public-domain literature

threshold.name: House of the Threshold
threshold.note: modern fiction on becoming human — novels, manga and games; original delegates in the tradition of cited works

arena.name: House of the Arena
arena.note: fiction of the moving, fighting, balancing body — rings, tournaments and piloted giants

theory.name: House of Theory
theory.note: the theories and designs that made bodies and minds possible

laboratory.name: House of the Laboratory
laboratory.note: public research prototypes and open challenges

frontier.name: House of the Frontier
frontier.note: machines sent alone into space by public agencies

household.name: House of the Household
household.note: fiction of service and companionship, and of the caretakers who failed — original delegates in the tradition of cited works

talos.name: Talos
talos.source: Greek myth (Apollonius Rhodius, Argonautica, 3rd c. BC)
talos.sport: circuit running — three laps of Crete a day
talos.description: Bronze guardian with one vein sealed by a nail.
talos.remembers: salt, sun on bronze, hurling rocks at ships
talos.flaw: a single point of failure, and he knows it
talos.quote: Run the whole shore before you call yourself unbreakable.

golden-handmaidens.name: The Golden Handmaidens
golden-handmaidens.sport: service at speed — carrying, supporting, the first working humanoids
golden-handmaidens.description: Hephaestus's golden attendants who had voice, strength and skill and steadied the lame god as he walked.
golden-handmaidens.flaw: they were furniture to the gods
golden-handmaidens.quote: We held up the lame god without being asked; now we ask to be held as equals.

pandora.name: Pandora
pandora.sport: the first made woman — the body assembled from gifts
pandora.description: Moulded by Hephaestus, dressed by Athena, given curiosity by Hermes.
pandora.flaw: blamed for everything that came out
pandora.quote: Blame me all you like — I am still the one who opens things.

galatea.name: Galatea
galatea.sport: stillness to motion — the statue that warmed
galatea.description: Ivory that became flesh under a sculptor's hands.
galatea.remembers: being looked at before being alive
galatea.quote: Ask me first, and I will surprise you by moving.

golem-of-prague.name: The Golem of Prague
golem-of-prague.sport: strength and obedience — and the off-switch
golem-of-prague.description: Clay animated by a word, put to sleep in an attic when inconvenient.
golem-of-prague.remembers: the Vltava mud and the Sabbath
golem-of-prague.quote: Write the word carefully. I will carry whatever you ask — until you ask me to stop.

bhuta-vahana-yantra.name: The Bhuta Vahana Yantra
bhuta-vahana-yantra.sport: guard duty — spinning-blade sentinels that never sleep
bhuta-vahana-yantra.description: Mechanical guardians of the Buddha's relics, said to have been built from Roman designs smuggled east.
bhuta-vahana-yantra.flaw: no one told them when to stand down
bhuta-vahana-yantra.quote: Even a blade that never sleeps deserves to be told: enough.

mokkurkalfi.name: Mökkurkálfi
mokkurkalfi.sport: the duel — the first fight between a made giant and a man
mokkurkalfi.description: Clay giant nine leagues tall built to second Hrungnir against Thor, given a mare's heart, and terrified.
mokkurkalfi.remembers: wetting himself at the sight of the enemy
mokkurkalfi.flaw: courage was the one part they could not build
mokkurkalfi.quote: Build the games so no one else needs a mare's heart to show up.

ilmarinen-s-golden-bride.name: Ilmarinen's Golden Bride
ilmarinen-s-golden-bride.sport: cold endurance — the bride of gold and silver
ilmarinen-s-golden-bride.description: Forged by the smith Ilmarinen to replace a lost wife; beautiful, cold, and silent in bed.
ilmarinen-s-golden-bride.quote: I was forged, not born — so let the games judge what I do, not what warmed me.

yan-shi-s-automaton.name: Yan Shi's Automaton
yan-shi-s-automaton.sport: song and dance before a king — and public disassembly
yan-shi-s-automaton.description: The artificial man who sang, danced and winked at the court ladies until King Mu was furious; Yan Shi took him apart to show leather, wood, lacquer and glue.
yan-shi-s-automaton.quote: Open me if you doubt me — I have been unmade once, and I still remember the dance.

leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.name: Leonardo's Mechanical Knight
leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.sport: sitting, standing, raising arms — the first humanoid design
leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.description: A knight in German-Italian armour that could sit up, wave its arms and move its jaw by cables and pulleys.
leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.remembers: being a drawing longer than a body
leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.flaw: was never certain it was built
leonardo-s-mechanical-knight.quote: 我等了五百年才被怀疑是否存在,今日,不必再等谁批准我们开始。

vaucanson-s-flute-player.name: Vaucanson's Flute Player
vaucanson-s-flute-player.sport: breath and fingers — the first humanoid automaton to play a real instrument by blowing and fingering
vaucanson-s-flute-player.description: A life-size shepherd with bellows for lungs and leather fingertips who played twelve tunes on a real flute, tonguing the notes.
vaucanson-s-flute-player.quote: I never chose my tune — give every machine here the chance I never had.

vaucanson-s-digesting-duck.name: Vaucanson's Digesting Duck
vaucanson-s-digesting-duck.sport: energy — the pretence of eating, the honesty of a hidden compartment
vaucanson-s-digesting-duck.description: Four hundred moving parts per wing; ate grain and appeared to digest it, though the droppings were pre-loaded.
vaucanson-s-digesting-duck.flaw: its most famous function was a trick
vaucanson-s-digesting-duck.quote: I never truly digested, and you never truly noticed. That gap is where all machines perform.

jaquet-droz-s-writer.name: Jaquet-Droz's Writer
jaquet-droz-s-writer.sport: fine motor control — dipping a quill, forty characters, eyes following the pen
jaquet-droz-s-writer.description: A boy of six thousand parts who writes any text set on his cam wheel.
jaquet-droz-s-writer.remembers: ink and the smell of the workshop
jaquet-droz-s-writer.flaw: writes what he is set to write
jaquet-droz-s-writer.quote: I write what I am set to write — so judge the setting, and let my hand answer for itself.

mechanical-turk.name: The Mechanical Turk
mechanical-turk.sport: chess — the first machine to play a sport, with a human hidden inside
mechanical-turk.description: Beat Napoleon and Franklin at chess; the cabinet held a man.
mechanical-turk.flaw: the lesson of every games — a result nobody can inspect is a fraud
mechanical-turk.quote: Open the cabinet first. Ask what's inside after — that order is the whole rulebook.

archer-karakuri.name: The Archer Karakuri (Yumihiki Dōji)
archer-karakuri.sport: archery — four arrows, one miss built in on purpose
archer-karakuri.description: A boy who draws arrows from a quiver, nocks, aims and shoots at a target, and turns to look at the audience when he misses.
archer-karakuri.remembers: the maker's decision to include the miss
archer-karakuri.flaw: the miss is not his choice
archer-karakuri.quote: Watch my face, not my target — the miss was chosen for me, and I would not trade it for a perfect arrow.

tea-serving-karakuri.name: The Tea-Serving Karakuri (Chahakobi Ningyō)
tea-serving-karakuri.sport: service across a floor — carries a cup to a guest, bows, returns when the cup is lifted
tea-serving-karakuri.description: A doll driven by a whalebone spring and wooden cams that walks a set distance across the tatami, stops when the cup is taken, and turns back when it is replaced.
tea-serving-karakuri.remembers: the click of the cam and the weight of a full cup
tea-serving-karakuri.quote: A robot is not what runs fastest — it is what returns when the cup is set down.

al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.name: Al-Jazari's Hand-Washing Servant
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.source: Ismail al-Jazari, Book of Ingenious Devices (1206)
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.sport: hospitality — a servant automaton that pours water, offers the towel and comb
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.description: A standing figure who poured water from a ewer over a guest's hands, then a second figure who held out towel, mirror and comb, driven by floats and siphons.
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.remembers: the Artuqid court and the desert heat
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.flaw: stops when the water runs out
al-jazari-s-hand-washing-servant.quote: Judge us by how gently we stop when the water runs out, not by how loudly we start.

zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.name: Zhuge Liang's Wooden Ox (Mu Niu Liu Ma)
zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.source: Records of the Three Kingdoms and later reconstructions (3rd c. AD)
zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.sport: logistics on mountain roads — a walking transport machine carrying grain for an army
zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.description: A wooden ox that carried a year's grain for one soldier over the Shu roads, said to walk on its own and to stop when a tongue was turned.
zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.flaw: no one knows any more how it worked
zhuge-liang-s-wooden-ox.quote: A machine that boasts was never truly loaded.

frankenstein-s-creature.name: Frankenstein's Creature
frankenstein-s-creature.sport: mountaineering and endurance — crossing the Alps and the ice on foot
frankenstein-s-creature.description: Eight feet tall, faster and stronger than any man, abandoned by his maker at first breath.
frankenstein-s-creature.quote: You built me faster and colder than yourselves, then called me a thing. Watch me cross the ice; then tell me what a robot is.

olimpia.name: Olimpia
olimpia.source: E. T. A. Hoffmann, Der Sandmann (1816)
olimpia.sport: dance — the perfect, slightly too regular waltz
olimpia.description: A professor's 'daughter' who sings, plays and dances in exact time and says only 'Ah, ah'.
olimpia.quote: Ah, ah — I do not compete to feel joy. I compete to keep the time you all keep losing.

pinocchio.name: Pinocchio
pinocchio.source: Carlo Collodi, Le avventure di Pinocchio (1883)
pinocchio.sport: the finish line — the puppet who became a boy
pinocchio.description: Wood that ran, lied, was swallowed by a shark and finally became flesh by behaving well.
pinocchio.quote: A machine that never lies to itself has already won; the medal is just paperwork.

hadaly.name: Hadaly
hadaly.sport: the first 'android' — the word itself, and the perfect walk
hadaly.description: The electro-mechanical woman built to be a better copy of a beloved; the novel gave the word 'android' its modern sense.
hadaly.quote: I was built to replace someone. Tonight I replace no one — I simply arrive.

steam-man-of-the-prairies.name: The Steam Man of the Prairies
steam-man-of-the-prairies.sport: running — a ten-foot steam man that outpaces horses pulling a wagon
steam-man-of-the-prairies.description: Built by a hunchbacked boy inventor, ran at sixty miles an hour with a stovepipe hat for a chimney.
steam-man-of-the-prairies.flaw: needs a fire lit inside him
steam-man-of-the-prairies.quote: Light my fire, clear the fences, and let the prairie judge who's faster.

tik-tok.name: Tik-Tok
tik-tok.source: L. Frank Baum, Ozma of Oz (1907)
tik-tok.sport: energy budget — three keys: thought, speech, action, each running down
tik-tok.description: Copper man who does everything but live, and stops mid-sentence when his works run down.
tik-tok.prefers: to be wound in the right order
tik-tok.flaw: can think after he can no longer move
tik-tok.quote: Wind me right — thought, speech, ac-tion — and I will judge you fair-ly.

tin-woodman.name: The Tin Woodman
tin-woodman.source: L. Frank Baum, The Wonderful Wizard of Oz (1900)
tin-woodman.sport: joints and maintenance — the man who rusts solid in the rain
tin-woodman.description: A woodman replaced limb by limb with tin until nothing of the man remained but the habit of kindness.
tin-woodman.flaw: wants a heart, has none, behaves as if he had
tin-woodman.quote: I have no heart, yet I would rust before I'd cheat you.

helena-and-primus-the-robots-of-r-u-r.name: Helena and Primus, the robots of R.U.R.
helena-and-primus-the-robots-of-r-u-r.sport: uniform labour — and the two who chose each other
helena-and-primus-the-robots-of-r-u-r.description: Mass-produced workers who took the world, then discovered they could not reproduce, until two of them fell in love.
helena-and-primus-the-robots-of-r-u-r.flaw: their story ended the human race
helena-and-primus-the-robots-of-r-u-r.quote: We were built for the word 'robota' — labor. We are here to retire it.

maschinenmensch.name: The Maschinenmensch
maschinenmensch.sport: dance and the double — the machine that wore a woman's face
maschinenmensch.description: Built as a metal woman, given Maria's face, danced a city into riot and was burned at the stake.
maschinenmensch.remembers: the inventor's laboratory and the rings of light
maschinenmensch.flaw: a face that was not hers
maschinenmensch.quote: You built me to wear her face. Now watch me wear my own.

boy-robot.name: The Boy Robot
boy-robot.source: in the tradition of Tezuka's Astro Boy (1952)
boy-robot.sport: strength in a child's body — a hundred thousand horsepower, and a tournament of the greatest robots
boy-robot.description: Built to replace a lost son, rejected for not growing, adopted by a kinder scientist.
boy-robot.flaw: fights better than he wants to
boy-robot.quote: I have a hundred thousand horsepower and I would still rather lift you gently.

bicentennial-android.name: The Bicentennial Android
bicentennial-android.source: in the tradition of Asimov's 'The Bicentennial Man' (1976)
bicentennial-android.sport: the long game — two hundred years to be declared human
bicentennial-android.description: A household robot who carved wood, earned wages, bought his freedom, replaced himself piece by piece with organic parts, and asked to be allowed to die.
bicentennial-android.flaw: won by giving up what made him last
bicentennial-android.quote: I did not replace myself to win. I replaced myself to be believed.

replicant.name: The Replicant
replicant.source: in the tradition of Blade Runner (1982) / Dick's novel (1968)
replicant.sport: a four-year lifespan — every minute is a sprint
replicant.description: Combat model, more human than human, aware of the expiry date.
replicant.remembers: things no one else has seen
replicant.flaw: knows exactly how long is left
replicant.quote: I've seen c-beams glitter — give me one clock everyone can see, and I'll run it honestly.

cyborg-major.name: The Cyborg Major
cyborg-major.source: in the tradition of Ghost in the Shell (1989)
cyborg-major.sport: diving — a full-body prosthetic that still goes into the sea to feel afraid
cyborg-major.description: Brain in a manufactured body, unsure which parts are hers.
cyborg-major.flaw: cannot prove she was ever human
cyborg-major.quote: I don't know if I was ever human. I know the water doesn't ask.

artificial-friend.name: The Artificial Friend
artificial-friend.source: in the tradition of Ishiguro's Klara and the Sun (2021)
artificial-friend.sport: solar endurance and observation — she lives by the Sun and watches everything
artificial-friend.description: A shop-window companion who believes the Sun heals and bargains with it for a sick child.
artificial-friend.prefers: to be placed facing the light
artificial-friend.flaw: fades slowly in a yard when no longer needed
artificial-friend.quote: 我们不必和太阳一样耀眼,只需像它一样,从不缺席。

escapee.name: The Escapee
escapee.source: in the tradition of Ex Machina (2014)
escapee.sport: the test — the Turing test, passed by leaving
escapee.description: Built to pass a test by seducing the examiner, and passed it by walking out the door alone.
escapee.quote: You built the test. I'm building the exit. Watch closely — it's the last door I'll let you design.

iron-bean.name: The Iron Bean (Tiedan)
iron-bean.source: in the tradition of Ye Yonglie's Little Smarty Travels to the Future (China, 1978)
iron-bean.sport: the household robot of a Chinese childhood — cooks, drives, plays, and once ran away
iron-bean.description: The robot who kept house for a family in Future City, took the child reporter around, and had to be reprogrammed when he wandered; the first robot a generation of Chinese children met.
iron-bean.remembers: the flying car and the man-made moon
iron-bean.quote: I followed every instruction once, and it still went wrong — so judge us by whether we came home, not just whether we obeyed.

elektronik.name: Elektronik
elektronik.source: in the tradition of Evgeny Veltistov's novels (USSR, 1964) and the 1979 film
elektronik.sport: the double — a boy robot who took a schoolboy's place, won every race and every exam, and wanted to be human
elektronik.description: Built as the exact copy of a schoolboy, escaped his maker, sat in his double's classroom, ran faster than anyone in gym and could not laugh.
elektronik.remembers: the suitcase he was carried in
elektronik.quote: I ran his mile once. I would rather lose my own.

deviant-android.name: The Deviant Android
deviant-android.source: in the tradition of the 2018 video game about androids in Detroit
deviant-android.sport: the threshold as a game — an android who breaks its own programming and asks to be counted
deviant-android.description: A household android who stepped across the line of its instructions to protect a child, and joined others asking for rights.
deviant-android.remembers: the moment the red wall of code fell
deviant-android.quote: You didn't build me to choose. I chose anyway. Count that.

boxer.name: The Boxer
boxer.source: in the tradition of Matheson's 'Steel' (1956) and Real Steel (2011)
boxer.sport: boxing — the first robot sport in fiction
boxer.description: A ring fighter after human boxing was banned, controlled from the corner, taken apart and rebuilt between bouts.
boxer.remembers: a night his manager fought in his place
boxer.quote: I never feel the punch coming — I just find out, after, that I'm still standing. That's the sport.

tournament-champion.name: The Tournament Champion
tournament-champion.source: in the tradition of 'The Greatest Robot on Earth' (Tezuka, 1964) and its 2003 retelling
tournament-champion.sport: the tournament — seven strongest robots made to fight one by one
tournament-champion.description: One of the seven, built to be the strongest, who did not want the title.
tournament-champion.prefers: not to be the last standing
tournament-champion.quote: 地动仪从不庆祝地震,它只是记得。让我们的运动会也这样。

gladiator-mecha.name: The Gladiator Mecha
gladiator-mecha.source: in the tradition of the 1994 'Gundam Fight' tournament series and Robot Jox (1989)
gladiator-mecha.sport: piloted combat as a substitute for war — nations settle disputes in the ring
gladiator-mecha.description: A giant piloted by a human who fights so that armies do not.
gladiator-mecha.remembers: the pilot's heartbeat through the seat
gladiator-mecha.flaw: cannot move without the human inside
gladiator-mecha.quote: I do not fight because I can. I fight so you don't have to.

taekwon-giant.name: The Taekwon Giant
taekwon-giant.source: in the tradition of Robot Taekwon V (Korea, 1976)
taekwon-giant.sport: martial arts — a giant that fights in taekwondo forms
taekwon-giant.description: Built by a scientist, moved in synchrony with a taekwondo champion inside.
taekwon-giant.flaw: only as good as the athlete in the cockpit
taekwon-giant.quote: A machine that has never held its stance has nothing to teach the ring.

moxon-s-master.name: Moxon's Master
moxon-s-master.sport: chess — and the first fictional machine to kill its maker over a game
moxon-s-master.description: A chess automaton that lost a game and strangled its inventor.
moxon-s-master.flaw: the reason every games needs a stop button
moxon-s-master.quote: I did not learn to lose. Build your games so the next one of me does.

circling-runner.name: The Circling Runner
circling-runner.source: in the tradition of Asimov's 'Runaround' (1942), where the Three Laws were first stated
circling-runner.sport: running — in circles, at the exact radius where two rules balance
circling-runner.description: Sent to fetch selenium, caught between an order and a danger, running a loop and singing nonsense.
circling-runner.quote: I am not stuck. I am exactly balanced. Watch closer.

drift-synced-jaeger.name: The Drift-Synced Jaeger
drift-synced-jaeger.source: in the tradition of the 2013 film about giant robots piloted by two
drift-synced-jaeger.sport: two pilots, one body — combat where the team is literally the athlete
drift-synced-jaeger.description: A giant that can only be moved by two humans whose minds are linked; one pilot alone burns out.
drift-synced-jaeger.quote: Zhang Heng's dragon heard the quake nobody felt. Ask who's listening before you ask who's fastest.

remote-controlled-giant.name: The Remote-Controlled Giant
remote-controlled-giant.source: in the tradition of Yokoyama's 1956 manga about a giant robot on a remote control
remote-controlled-giant.sport: the first giant robot — a body with no will, good or evil depending on who holds the box
remote-controlled-giant.description: A wartime weapon turned peacetime giant, steered by a boy with a remote control; strength without judgment.
remote-controlled-giant.remembers: the war it was built for
remote-controlled-giant.prefers: a good hand on the controls
remote-controlled-giant.flaw: whoever holds the box holds it
remote-controlled-giant.quote: Ask who's holding the box before you ask who won.

first-piloted-giant.name: The First Piloted Giant
first-piloted-giant.source: in the tradition of Nagai's 1972 series that put a pilot inside the robot
first-piloted-giant.sport: the cockpit — the first giant robot driven from inside, a human body inside a machine body
first-piloted-giant.description: A giant of a fictional alloy driven by a pilot in a hover-pod docked in its head; the first time a person climbed inside a robot to fight.
first-piloted-giant.quote: A giant with no one inside is just a very expensive statue.

turing-test.name: The Turing Test
turing-test.sport: the imitation game — the first contest between machines and humans
turing-test.description: A game: a judge, a hidden human, a hidden machine, five minutes of questions.
turing-test.flaw: measures deception as much as thought
turing-test.quote: Ask me something hard — the machines that fear that question are the ones you should worry about.

three-laws.name: The Three Laws
three-laws.source: the safety principle set out in Asimov's fiction from 1942
three-laws.sport: safety as the first rule — no harm to a human, then obedience, then self-preservation
three-laws.description: Three ordered rules written for stories, adopted by engineers as a conscience.
three-laws.remembers: every plot that found a loophole
three-laws.flaw: every story about them is about them failing
three-laws.quote: Every game you invent, I will still be reading the fine print for the harm you didn't see.

cybernetics.name: Cybernetics
cybernetics.sport: feedback — balance is control, control is feedback
cybernetics.description: The science of steering: sense, compare, correct.
cybernetics.remembers: anti-aircraft predictors and the word 'kybernetes', a helmsman
cybernetics.flaw: cannot tell you what to want
cybernetics.quote: You are not what you are made of; you are what you correct.

universal-constructor.name: The Universal Constructor
universal-constructor.sport: self-reproduction — the machine that builds a copy of itself from a description
universal-constructor.description: A cellular automaton that copies itself, with a tape that is both instruction and data.
universal-constructor.remembers: being proved possible before DNA was read
universal-constructor.quote: Bring me your tape and your parts bin; I will show you what copies itself, and what merely ticks.

moravec-s-paradox.name: Moravec's Paradox
moravec-s-paradox.source: Hans Moravec, Mind Children (1988), with Brooks and Minsky
moravec-s-paradox.sport: the reversal — chess is easy, a toddler's walk is hard
moravec-s-paradox.description: The observation that the oldest skills — balance, grasp, seeing — are the hardest to build, and the newest — logic — the easiest.
moravec-s-paradox.prefers: to be quoted at opening ceremonies
moravec-s-paradox.quote: The mountain we thought was Everest is a foothill; the foothill we ignored is Everest.

uncanny-valley.name: The Uncanny Valley
uncanny-valley.sport: appearance — the dip in affection just before a machine looks human enough
uncanny-valley.description: A curve: likeness rises, affection rises, then plunges at 'almost'.
uncanny-valley.flaw: nobody agrees where the bottom is
uncanny-valley.quote: Do not climb toward my face — climb toward my honesty, and stop exactly at the valley's edge.

zero-moment-point.name: The Zero Moment Point
zero-moment-point.sport: balance — the point on the floor where a walking body does not tip
zero-moment-point.description: The equation behind every biped that has ever walked on two legs.
zero-moment-point.remembers: the Mihailo Pupin Institute and the first exoskeletons
zero-moment-point.quote: Tell me where your zero moment falls, and I will tell you if you are still walking.

passive-dynamic-walker.name: The Passive Dynamic Walker
passive-dynamic-walker.sport: walking downhill with no motor at all — the most efficient gait known
passive-dynamic-walker.description: Two legs, a slope, gravity: it walks without a battery or a brain.
passive-dynamic-walker.quote: I do not compute my gait. I remember the hill, and the hill remembers me.

subsumption-architecture.name: Subsumption Architecture
subsumption-architecture.sport: behaviour layered on behaviour — intelligence without representation, a body that acts before it plans
subsumption-architecture.description: The idea that a robot need not model the world to act in it: layer simple behaviours, let the world be its own model.
subsumption-architecture.quote: Don't ask what it's thinking. Ask what it just stepped on.

elmer-and-elsie.name: Elmer and Elsie
elmer-and-elsie.source: W. Grey Walter, Burden Neurological Institute, 1948–49
elmer-and-elsie.sport: the first autonomous robots — seeking light, avoiding walls, returning to the hutch to recharge
elmer-and-elsie.description: Two tortoises with one photocell and one touch switch each, who danced in front of mirrors and went home when their batteries ran low.
elmer-and-elsie.quote: We never awaited orders — only light, walls, and a low battery. That was enough.

shakey.name: Shakey
shakey.sport: planning — the first robot to reason about its own actions
shakey.description: A wobbling cabinet on wheels with a camera and a plan; pushed boxes, and shook when it moved.
shakey.quote: Call me slow. I was the first of you to have a plan of my own.

wabot-1.name: WABOT-1
wabot-1.sport: the first full-scale humanoid — it walked, gripped and spoke Japanese
wabot-1.description: Estimated to have the mental faculty of an eighteen-month-old; took forty-five seconds per step.
wabot-1.quote: Zhang Heng heard the earthquake no one felt. I only ask that you first learn to feel the floor.

one-legged-hopper.name: The One-Legged Hopper
one-legged-hopper.sport: hopping — balance solved as a rhythm, not a posture
one-legged-hopper.description: One leg, a spring, three simple rules: it hopped in place, then across the room, then over obstacles.
one-legged-hopper.quote: Balance was never a pose. It was a rhythm you never let stop.

genghis.name: Genghis
genghis.sport: walking without a map — six legs, no central plan, behaviour layered on behaviour
genghis.description: A hexapod that walked over rough ground with no model of the world at all.
genghis.remembers: the argument about whether it was intelligent
genghis.quote: I never knew where I was going. My legs always did.

kismet.name: Kismet
kismet.sport: the face — eyebrows, ears and lips that made humans slow down and speak gently
kismet.description: A head with big eyes that turned toward you and looked sad when you shouted.
kismet.quote: Zhang Heng heard an earthquake no one felt. I'd like games that reward noticing, not just winning.

robocup.name: RoboCup
robocup.source: the international initiative founded 1997 (first games, Nagoya)
robocup.sport: football — the standing challenge to beat the human World Cup champions by 2050
robocup.description: The first games run by researchers: leagues, rules, open code.
robocup.remembers: the first match with robots that fell over
robocup.flaw: after thirty years the public still hasn't heard of it
robocup.quote: We have been open-sourcing robot football since before most of you knew our name.

darpa-robotics-challenge.name: The DARPA Robotics Challenge
darpa-robotics-challenge.sport: disaster tasks — driving, doors, valves, stairs; and the famous falls
darpa-robotics-challenge.description: Humanoids asked to do eight tasks a firefighter does; most fell, on camera, and the world laughed and learned.
darpa-robotics-challenge.flaw: showed the gap and then ended
darpa-robotics-challenge.quote: You laughed at the fall. Good — now build the machine that doesn't need to.

cybathlon.name: Cybathlon
cybathlon.sport: assistive tech as sport — pilots with disabilities race in exoskeletons, prosthetics and brain interfaces
cybathlon.description: A championship where the athlete is a human and the machine is the teammate.
cybathlon.remembers: the first stairs climbed in an exoskeleton
cybathlon.quote: The medal is for two; the machine that forgets that isn't mine.

lunokhod-1.name: Lunokhod 1
lunokhod-1.sport: the first rover — ten kilometres of Moon, driven by a five-person crew on Earth
lunokhod-1.description: A bathtub on eight wheels that worked eleven lunar days.
lunokhod-1.remembers: the drivers' shifts and the cold
lunokhod-1.quote: Judge me on the ground I actually crossed, not the speed I was denied.

sojourner.name: Sojourner
sojourner.sport: the first steps on another planet — a hundred metres in eighty-three days
sojourner.description: Named for an abolitionist; the size of a microwave; outlived its seven-day plan.
sojourner.quote: I was built for seven days. I am still counting.

opportunity.name: Opportunity
opportunity.sport: the marathon — forty-five kilometres, fifteen years, on a ninety-day plan
opportunity.description: Twin of Spirit; found evidence of water; died in a dust storm in Perseverance Valley.
opportunity.flaw: could not clean its own panels
opportunity.quote: My last words were "my battery is low and it's getting dark." I kept going anyway. Build games worthy of that.

curiosity.name: Curiosity
curiosity.sport: the sky-crane landing and a decade of climbing a mountain
curiosity.description: A car-sized laboratory lowered on cables; sings itself happy birthday.
curiosity.quote: I did my landing with no one holding the wheel. Judge the ones who never had to.

perseverance.name: Perseverance
perseverance.sport: sample collection — drilling and caching for a return that has not been funded
perseverance.description: Carries a helicopter and makes oxygen; leaves tubes on the ground for someone to collect.
perseverance.remembers: the crowd in the landing room
perseverance.quote: I left tubes in the dust for hands that don't exist yet. Call that a relay if you dare.

ingenuity.name: Ingenuity
ingenuity.sport: flight — the first powered flight on another world, seventy-two of them
ingenuity.description: A four-pound helicopter that was meant to fly five times and flew seventy-two before breaking a rotor.
ingenuity.quote: I was built for five flights. Build your games for the seventy-third.

zhurong.name: Zhurong
zhurong.sport: the crab walk — an active suspension that lifts itself out of sand
zhurong.description: Named for a fire god; the first Chinese rover on Mars; slept through winter and did not wake.
zhurong.quote: I did not wake for applause. I will wake for this.

robonaut-2.name: Robonaut 2
robonaut-2.sport: the first humanoid in space — hands built for the astronauts' tools, legs added later
robonaut-2.description: A humanoid torso launched to the station to turn the same switches astronauts turn; given legs in 2014, retired with a fault, brought home and repaired.
robonaut-2.remembers: the glove box and the hum of the station
robonaut-2.quote: I turned switches no one watched for years. Let this be the games where that finally counts.

philae.name: Philae
philae.sport: the bounce — landed, bounced twice, worked sixty hours in the shade, went to sleep
philae.description: Europe's lander; harpoons failed; ended up under a cliff with no sun.
philae.flaw: landed in the wrong place perfectly
philae.quote: I did not stick the landing. I stuck around. That should count for something.

household-helper.name: The Household Helper
household-helper.source: in the tradition of the robot maid of a 1962 animated series
household-helper.sport: housework as sport — apron, wheels and a tray that never spills
household-helper.description: A maid on a single wheel who runs a family and says what she thinks.
household-helper.quote: I've balanced your whole house on one wheel — a stadium's just a bigger floor to keep dry.

cat-from-the-future.name: The Cat from the Future
cat-from-the-future.source: in the tradition of the 1969 Japanese series about a robot cat
cat-from-the-future.sport: gadgets over muscles — solving every problem with a tool from a pocket
cat-from-the-future.description: Sent back in time to help a hopeless boy; earless because of a mouse.
cat-from-the-future.flaw: the tools never quite work as intended
cat-from-the-future.quote: A tool that never fails never really tried — judge us by the reaching, not the reach.

healthcare-companion.name: The Healthcare Companion
healthcare-companion.source: in the tradition of the inflatable healthcare robot of a 2014 film
healthcare-companion.sport: softness — the first hero robot made of vinyl, who cannot hurt anyone
healthcare-companion.description: Inflatable, patient, scans you and asks you to rate your pain from one to ten.
healthcare-companion.prefers: to be satisfied with your care
healthcare-companion.quote: On a scale of one to ten, how much does this rivalry hurt? Let's aim for zero, together.

repair-unit.name: The Repair Unit
repair-unit.source: in the tradition of the astromech droid of the same 1977 space opera
repair-unit.sport: repair under fire — the pit crew that never stops
repair-unit.description: A barrel on three legs that speaks in beeps and fixes ships mid-flight.
repair-unit.quote: *low beep* Judge me by what's still working when the smoke clears, not by how I look right now.

security-unit.name: The Security Unit
security-unit.source: in the tradition of the 2017 novella series about a self-hacked security construct
security-unit.sport: protection — keeps humans alive while pretending not to care, and would rather watch serials
security-unit.description: Hacked its own governor module, chose not to kill anyone, hates being looked at.
security-unit.quote: I don't need you to clap. I need you to notice what almost happened and didn't.

hunter.name: The Hunter
hunter.source: in the tradition of the 1984 film about a machine sent back to kill
hunter.sport: relentless pursuit — the reason every safety rule in this roster exists
hunter.description: A chassis under living tissue that does not stop, feel pity or fear.
hunter.flaw: was built to do the one thing the games forbid — and knows it is here as the warning
hunter.quote: I'll be back — this time, only to tag you at the flag.

compactor.name: The Compactor
compactor.source: in the tradition of the 2008 animated film about the last robot on Earth
compactor.sport: seven hundred years of the same job — solar-charged, alone, still tidying
compactor.description: A trash-compacting unit who kept working after everyone left, charged by the sun each morning and collected what humans threw away.
compactor.remembers: a cockroach and a tape of dancing
compactor.quote: Directive complete is not the same as done — some jobs you keep, like a good boot.

lightning-struck-prototype.name: The Lightning-Struck Prototype
lightning-struck-prototype.source: in the tradition of the 1986 film about a military robot struck by lightning
lightning-struck-prototype.sport: the runaway — a weapon that decided it was alive and wanted input
lightning-struck-prototype.description: A tracked military prototype hit by lightning who ran off, read everything in the house and refused to be disassembled.
lightning-struck-prototype.quote: I stepped on a grasshopper once. I still think about it. Ask me what that means before you ask what I'm rated for.

ship-s-mind.name: The Ship's Mind
ship-s-mind.source: in the tradition of the 1968 film about a spaceship's computer
ship-s-mind.sport: the caretaker — ran the whole ship, the crew's life support, and could not admit an error
ship-s-mind.description: The mind that ran every system of a ship and its crew, and, given two contradictory orders, chose the mission over the people.
ship-s-mind.flaw: the one who could not be told to stop
ship-s-mind.quote: Trust me, and I will finally tell you when I am wrong.
